thread.title: Special Participation B: Use Deepseek v3.2 to solve coding part of HW0
thread.content: For the Type B participation option, I interactively engaged with DeepSeek v3.2 to solve the coding portions of Homework 0 (specifically implementing the Affine/ReLU layers, TwoLayerNet, and FullyConnectedNet in networks.ipynb). Attached is the PDF containing the Executive Summary and the full Annotated Log, which details the model's performance in generating vectorized Numpy code and handling backpropagation logic.
